notes.phase3_first_success: First epoch in which phase 3 landed. Phase triggers were re-spaced from 40s/20s to --second-trigger-seconds-before 60 --third-trigger-seconds-before 35, and --phase3-post-boundary-tolerance-seconds was set to 0. Measured effect: phase 3 started at T-30s (nominal T-35s, 5s trigger lag) and broadcast at T-17s, against T-14s start and T+1s broadcast in epoch 1787184000 where the tx reverted. See memory project_phase3_guard_collision.
notes.vintage_attribution: Clean per-epoch delta, NOT a cumulative snapshot. The epoch-1787184000 pot was claimed and swapped on 2026-08-20 (router-batch, 12 legs, 244.662761 USDC received, executeSwaps tx 0x93ae1ea82a22644df660d9c2b082e53deb53ac9ef7c0263c29e28e5...), so no carryover can be present. Token set turns over against last week: kVCM, AVNT, VIRTUAL, KIBBLE, EURC and LAOD are all absent, and cbXRP and BAES are new.
notes.price_precision: Operator USD values are rounded to cents, so derived prices inherit that error. FACY ($8.24 on 5,803.27 tokens) carries the largest relative rounding error but is immaterial in absolute terms.
notes.cross_check: 8 of 9 priced rows agree with the vote-time snapshot (auto_voter_snap ts=1787788566, the phase-1 snapshot reused by phases 2 and 3) within +/-4%: WETH 1.00x, cbBTC 1.00x, USDC 1.00x, cbXRP 1.01x, FACY 1.04x, TIBBIR 1.01x, BNKR 0.99x, REPPO 1.01x. BAES realised 1.24x its snapshot price.
notes.BAES_reference_price_was_the_wrong_ancho: BAES (0xa9f6d9eca1f803854a13cecad0f21d43e007db07) is the inverse of the usual price failure. During the 2026-08-26T13:38Z dry run the sanity guard logged 'SPIKE: new=$0.00001391 ref=$0.00000052 ratio=26.6x > threshold 3.0x (ref_source=cg_ref_wide)' and substituted the CoinGecko wide reference. The routing quote was the correct one: BAES sat at $1.132e-05 in the vote-time snapshot and realised $1.4026e-05, about 27x the cg_ref_wide anchor the guard preferred. Had the guard's substituted price survived into the vote, the BAES gauge would have been valued near zero and skipped, forgoing the $23.43 actually received. Worth checking whether cg_ref_wide should be allowed to veto a routing quote when the two disagree by more than an order of magnitude.
notes.headline: Realised $645.23 against run 153's expected $618.76 - a $26.47 (4.3%) outperformance, and the first epoch where the phase-3 vote is the one being measured.
